scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplies universal scope; exact-rational and seeded finite tests provide reproducibility but not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Planar bilinear saddle, multiplicative bivariate Gaussian oracle, equal fixed positive steps, independent paired draws across iterations and exact arithmetic; not a theorem for arbitrary stochastic VIPs or non-Gaussian noise. Relevant 2026 primary full text was inaccessible for complete bibliographic comparison.
title: Sharp sample-reuse and step-size phase diagram for Gaussian stochastic extragradient on a bilinear saddle
